test: Follow one service question from entry page to next action
expected_behavior: The intended visitor can identify fit and reach a clear next step
needs_access_status: Public page; record device and task

test: Compare package/service boundary with contact entry
expected_behavior: Chosen service and key scope remain clear through the next step

test: Read the headline and main service explanation together
expected_behavior: They answer one identifiable customer question without contradictory scope

test: Check proof; location claims; prices and exclusions
expected_behavior: Claims have evidence; actual delivery/location is clear; prices and exclusions match the accepted offer
needs_access_status: Approved facts and offer authority needed

test: Open important internal links and expected final URLs
expected_behavior: Each link reaches the intended useful destination without a broken or misleading route
needs_access_status: Public pages; server access may be needed for diagnosis

test: Compare canonical; robots meta/header and indexing policy
expected_behavior: Controls agree with the intended publication policy; deliberate noindex is recorded rather than silently removed
needs_access_status: Owner indexing decision required; Search Console needs authorized access

test: Repeat the main task at narrow phone width and enlarged text
expected_behavior: Important content and controls remain readable and usable without lost information

test: Observe cold loading and content movement
expected_behavior: Primary content arrives in a useful order; layout changes do not disrupt the task
needs_access_status: Record date; connection; device; lab versus field method

test: Use the main path with keyboard only
expected_behavior: Relevant controls can be reached and operated; focus stays visible and follows a useful order
needs_access_status: Public page; does not constitute full accessibility testing

test: Inspect labels; image alternatives; enlarged text and reduced-motion behavior
expected_behavior: Controls have understandable labels; meaningful images have useful alternatives; motion and text settings preserve the task
needs_access_status: Assistive-technology and human checks may be needed

test: Try an agreed invalid example and inspect recovery
expected_behavior: Useful field errors explain the problem; chosen service and safe entered values survive retry
needs_access_status: Agree synthetic data and test scope; do not include private information

test: Verify browser confirmation; stored record and notification separately
expected_behavior: An authorized synthetic test establishes each claimed stage with a dated reference
needs_access_status: Needs explicit test authorization and appropriate storage/inbox access; invalid response is not a saved inquiry

test: Identify domain; hosting; CMS and workflow account owners
expected_behavior: The actual owners and delegated permissions are documented without sharing credentials

test: Inspect a recoverable version; export and restore procedure
expected_behavior: A safe authorized recovery exercise establishes the claimed recovery step and its limits
needs_access_status: Needs safe environment; backup; permission; agreed rollback

test: Define the decision and inspect relevant page/query or inquiry evidence
expected_behavior: Source; dates; sample and access limits are recorded; unavailable data is not treated as zero
needs_access_status: Needs authorized analytics/Search Console/inquiry evidence where applicable

test: Compare the changed task with its original evidence
expected_behavior: Retest verifies the correction; business/search effects are labeled as observations with limits
needs_access_status: Use private records safely; public receipts omit personal data
